decisions.diagnosis: A morning surge of northbound riders was a real organised ride, not corruption, and the southbound day was normal, so the impossible_count/corrupt_day removal should be undone.
decisions.evidence: North 183/312/170 in 07:30-08:15 (day 726 vs ~70) and the next day (Sunday) a matching southbound surge of 649 (peak 91/slot, 10:00-14:30) was kept; adjacent site 210 also doubled on both days (255 and 280 vs ~124); southbound 10-10 was 94, normal.

decisions.diagnosis: Zeros during the June 2016 East Coast Low storm are real: nobody rode the riverside path, and the other direction was also near zero.
decisions.evidence: North had 3 bikes across the same hours; southbound resumed normally on the morning of 06-06 (5,4,3 per hour).

decisions.diagnosis: Zeros on a quiet (probably wet) Sunday are real low riding, since the other direction was also zero through the same hours.
decisions.evidence: North was 0 from 00:00 to 14:00 and 9 for the day; south recorded 3 at 18h and was normal on the next day.

decisions.diagnosis: Zeros during the February 2020 Sydney flood rain are real, and the other direction was also near zero.
decisions.evidence: South had 2 bikes for all of 02-09; north resumed at 08:00 on 02-10.

decisions.diagnosis: Zeros during the March 2021 NSW floods are real, with the other direction also near zero.
decisions.evidence: North had 3 bikes on 03-20 and 0 before 13:00 on 03-21; south resumed at 15:00 on 03-21.

decisions.diagnosis: Zeros on a near-empty Sunday are real, since the other direction also recorded almost nothing.
decisions.evidence: North had 3 bikes all day against ~60 on the day before; south had 1 at 06h and 2 at 18h, and was normal on the next day.

decisions.diagnosis: Zeros in both directions during the July 2022 Sydney floods are real (the riverside path was flooded or deserted).
decisions.evidence: Both directions stopped almost together and recorded 1-2 bikes each; low riding continued on 07-04/05 (~12-15/day).

decisions.diagnosis: Zeros on a quiet Saturday at a low-volume direction are plausibly real (very few riders), not an outage.
decisions.evidence: North had 11 bikes all day; south had 4 and recovered by the evening, then was normal on 05-12 (~13).

decisions.diagnosis: Both directions decline gradually to about a third of the pre-2021 level while adjacent site 210 holds steady; this may be a real route shift or a slow loss of sensor sensitivity.
decisions.evidence: Yearly means at 209 N/S: 2019 53/65, 2022 32/37, 2025 18/21; at 210: 269/254, 307/296, 310/283. There is no step change, the daily profiles stay normal and the direction split is stable.

summary: One Metrocount piezo (counter 193) with two directions and a clean, continuous record from 2015-06 to 2025-09, after which the southbound direction stops and the northbound direction reads zero (correctly set missing). Most automatic zero_outage fixes landed on flood or wet weekends, when both directions were near zero, so they are restored, as is the 2015-10-10 organised-ride surge. A gradual decline relative to adjacent site 210 since 2021 is noted as uncertain.
